name: dsh-lsp-actions-vscode
description: Minimal VS Code extension consuming the dsh-lsp-actions editor action protocol over ACP-style JSON-RPC. UI only — every LSP capability is served by the plugin backend.

commands.title: DSH: Connect to the editor backend
DSH: Disconnect from the editor backend
DSH: Refresh diagnostics for the active file
DSH: Open the file at this diagnostic
DSH: Format the active document (through the backend)

dshLspActions.backend.node.description: The Node.js executable used to launch the editor backend.

dshLspActions.backend.bin.description: Absolute path to the backend bin.mjs (examples/vscode/backend/bin.mjs). Empty falls back to the bundled example path resolution.

dshLspActions.backend.config.description: Absolute path to the backend cordis.yml. Empty falls back to the bin's default lookup.
